snippet.title: 🔴 Murder Masquerade | New Social Deduction Game
snippet.description:
Check Out A New Social Deduction Game:
https://murdermasquerade.com/

Social deduction meets mystery in Murder Masquerade, a game where the killer hides among the suspects, and even the innocents may bend the truth to frame or protect the others.

We are proud to show off this new Social Deduction game we have been working on playtesting over the last 6 months! The Devs are ready for us to show off the Pre Release (alpha Testing) gameplay with you! And hopefully get you excited about the release of the game!

This group started with a couple of friends who wanted to play some Blood on the Clocktower, and slowly has grown by adding new faces from the community. We don't try to be the best in the world at it, or take it too seriously: our goal is to get together, have some fun, and walk away smiling. If that sounds like your cup of tea, consider dropping into our Discord Community to play some games with us: https://join.thegrim.gg


CHAPTERS
00:00:00 - Starting Soon
